# CorpErgo Physiotherapy

CorpErgo Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation is a physiotherapy clinic chain in Bengaluru, India.
Website: https://corpergo.in/
Booking page: https://corpergo.in/direct-booking
Phone: +91 91485 36394
Email: care@corpergo.in
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/corpergophysiorehab.in/

## What CorpErgo Does

CorpErgo provides evidence-based physiotherapy for pain relief, mobility restoration, sports injury rehabilitation, post-surgery recovery, neurological rehabilitation, posture correction, women's health physiotherapy, pediatric physiotherapy and geriatric physiotherapy.

## Locations

CorpErgo has physiotherapy clinics in Bengaluru at Chansandra, Balagere, Muthsandra, Kannamangala and Manduru. The clinics serve Whitefield, Varthur, Bengaluru East and nearby areas.

## Key People

Dr. Pinky Dutta PT is presented on the website as Founder and Head of Department at CorpErgo. Her clinical focus includes musculoskeletal and sports physiotherapy.

## Public Pages

- Home: https://corpergo.in/
- Direct appointment booking: https://corpergo.in/direct-booking

## Private App Areas

The patient portal, physiotherapist portal and admin portal are private application areas. They are not intended as public search landing pages.

## Common Answers

Patients can request an appointment online without logging in. Clinic staff call to confirm the booking.
Most physiotherapy sessions run 45 to 60 minutes depending on the condition and treatment plan.
A doctor's referral is not required for the first assessment, but reports, prescriptions or imaging can help the physiotherapist plan care faster.
